caption: Each resource is priced in its own billing unit, then the three lines are added. The disk line is tiny because 10 hours is only 2.74 of a 730-hour month, so 200 GB costs ₹2.19 while CPU and RAM reach ₹240 each.

spec.title: 10-hour run: 120 samples, ₹482.19
spec.aria: Three cost lines — CPU ₹240 from 40 vCPU-hours, RAM ₹240 from 160 GB-hours and disk ₹2.19 from 2.74 GB-month — add up to a total of ₹482.19 for the 10-hour run.
